text: Done: asked Professor Alvarez and he agreed to Wednesday 10:00-10:30. He says his calendar still shows the faculty senate meeting then, so the department office is confirming it is cancelled this week; he will book it on his side and write back once he hears. I replied that I'll keep the slot free and move it if anything is wrong.
Update: the senate meeting turned out not to be cancelled, so 10:00 was out. Professor Alvarez offered 12:30-13:00 or 15:00-15:30; I took 12:30-13:00 and he has booked it and confirmed.
